digest.component_or_area: graph link store and reconciler inbound application
propositions: Write is relation-scoped (add_dependency keys on (target_id, relation)) but removal is pair-scoped (_get_link_info returns most-recent link for target without relation filter), causing asymmetry that prevents convergence when one pair holds two differently-related links
Inbound removal record for one relation survives guard G5 when the pair's net-active relation differs from the vanished one, and re-emits every pass without converging
Guard G5 decline is permanent: the removal record re-declines on subsequent passes, causing the reconciler to never converge for a double-related pair
Relation-scoped removal seam (graph/_links.remove_dependency) must be added symmetric with add_dependency, validating relation and writing UNLINK event through shared locked write seam
Inbound removal path (_inbound_unlink_one) must use relation-scoped removal so G5 decline case converges by removing exactly the mirrored relation

CLI unlink must accept optional relation argument to remain backward compatible: with no relation, existing pair-scoped most-recent behavior is unchanged; with relation, removal is scoped to that relation
